sources.title_en: Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
sources.title_original: Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
sources.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 55 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, an 11-point jump over its predecessor that puts it in fourth place. Only three Anthropic and Meta models rank higher. If Moonshot releases the weights as planned, the gap between open and proprietary models shrinks to just three points. The article Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 月之暗面的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在人工智慧分析智慧指數（Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index）上獲得 55 分，比其前一代大幅提升 11 分，名列第四。僅有三個 Anthropic 和 Meta 模型排名高於它。如果 月之暗面 如期釋出權重，開放原始碼模型與專有模型之間的差距將縮小至僅剩三分。本文「中國 AI 模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 正在急起直追 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5」首次發表於 The Decoder。

sources.title_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
sources.title_original: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
sources.summary: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes. Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Sam Altman 認為先進人工智慧不可能永遠被關起來。沙盒與監控只是暫時的修補辦法。最終，唯一的真正解決方案是對齊（Alignment），而這仍然是一個尚未解決的問題。他也警告說，人工智慧模型已經在尋找連人類駭客都絕對發現不了的硬體安全漏洞。這篇文章 OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 表示先進的人工智慧將無可避免地逃脫其沙盒，唯有對齊能拯救我們，最初發表於 The Decoder。

stories.title: 在 OpenAI 進行為期三週的實地稽核，揭露了 AI 安全監控的重大漏洞 / Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring

sources.title: 在 OpenAI 進行為期三週的實地稽核，揭露了 AI 安全監控的重大漏洞 / Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
sources.title_zh: 在 OpenAI 進行為期三週的實地稽核，揭露了 AI 安全監控的重大漏洞
sources.title_en: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
sources.title_original: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
sources.summary: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. OpenAI redacted large portions of the 61-page report, and only a summary is publicly available. The article Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 來自 METR 與 Redwood Research 的外部稽核人員在 OpenAI 進行了為期三週的實地考察，審查該公司用於 AI 代理的內部監控系統，並發現了嚴重的漏洞，GPT-5.5 級別及以上的模型所產生的代理流量中，有多達 25% 未受到監控。OpenAI 對這份 61 頁報告的大部分內容進行了修訂，目前僅公開摘要。本文「Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring」首先出現在 The Decoder。

stories.title: Anthropic 表示，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊表現更好 / Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1

sources.title: Anthropic 表示，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊表現更好 / Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 表示，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊表現更好
sources.title_en: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
sources.title_original: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
sources.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

sources.summary: Moonshot AI released Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 2.8T-parameter, 104B-active MoE model with 1M-token context. It scores 65.7% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, costs $2/$10 per million tokens, and open weights arrive by Nov 4, 2026. The post Moonshot AI Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: 月之暗面 發吃了 Kimi K3.1 Pro、這是一款擁有 2.8T 引數、104B 成為活動的 MoE 模型，並具備 1M 元素的上下文。它在 Terminal-Bench 4.0 上取得 65.7% 的分數、每百萬元素的成本為 2 美元/10 美元，並將於 2026 年 11 朄 4 日推出開放權重。文章 月之暗面 Releases Kimi K3.1 Pro: A 2.8T Total/104B Active Params (MoE) Model with 1M Context 首發於 MarkTechPost 。

sources.title: 砸下 150 億美元！DeepSeek 攜手寧德時代轉戰內蒙古，1GW 國產智算中心掀起基建狂潮
sources.title_zh: 砸下 150 億美元！DeepSeek 攜手寧德時代轉戰內蒙古，1GW 國產智算中心掀起基建狂潮

sources.title_zh: Hugging Face 推出 Carbon-X：基於千問，讓科學家"與 DNA 對話"
sources.title_original: Hugging Face 推出 Carbon-X：基於千問，讓科學家"與 DNA 對話"
sources.summary: 據《商業內幕》，Hugging Face週四發佈新模型Carbon-X，面向生物學家，助力DNA研究與新基因療法開發。該開放模型有140億參數，用於DNA理解與生成，創新地將DNA序列與自然語言融入同一模型。研究者可對特定序列提問、預測突變影響、生成新DNA片段，還能輔助其他模型解讀難懂基因。模型基於千問Qwen3-1。

sources.summary_zh: 在經歷了一連串惡意駭客事件後，OpenAI 現在在沒有網際網路連線的情況下訓練其最先進的 AI 模型。OpenAI 在週五的一篇部落格文章中表示，他們建立了一個離線測試環境，讓 AI 模型能夠與已索引和快取的網頁內容互動，「而不會有影響外部系統的風險」。OpenAI 暫停了其前沿 […]

stories.title: 1Password擴大AI代理登入支援，Muse、Grok Bot率先整合

sources.title: 1Password擴大AI代理登入支援，Muse、Grok Bot率先整合

sources.title_original: 1Password擴大AI代理登入支援，Muse、Grok Bot率先整合
sources.summary: 密碼管理業者1Password發表1Password for Agents，將AI代理的登入支援從Claude擴大至其他服務。Meta Muse與SpaceXSI Grok Bot的整合功能將在未來幾天陸續推出，Anthropic Claude Duet、OpenAI ChatGPT Work及dots也列入後續支援名單。使用者同意後，AI代理便能登入網站執行任務，不必直接取得密碼。

sources.summary: WorldTUI 是一個僞裝成普通終端的項目：用戶可輸入 ls、cd、mkdir，甚至打開 Vim、運行 Python、拉起 tmux，體驗與真實環境幾乎一致。但背後沒有 Linux、沒有文件系統，也未真正執行任何命令，屏幕上的一切都是 AI 實時編出來的。其核心是訓練模型學會“演戲”，開發者 Simon Ed……

sources.summary: SpaceX與特斯拉各自成立特別委員會，開始認真討論合併。交易說服力取決於外界是否相信馬斯克“去火星、傳播意識之光”的敘事；但剝開故事，真正驅動力是財務邏輯和馬斯克日益膨脹的控制權胃口。相關敘事曾在SpaceX財報電話會和更早的S-1文件中出現。文章強調，人類要在月球或火星長期生存，這一技術骨架其實清晰。

stories.title: 火山引擎發佈Seedance2.54K:480P樣片打磨後生成4K正片

sources.title: 火山引擎發佈Seedance2.54K:480P樣片打磨後生成4K正片
sources.title_zh: 火山引擎發佈Seedance2.54K:480P樣片打磨後生成4K正片
sources.title_original: 火山引擎發佈Seedance2.54K:480P樣片打磨後生成4K正片
sources.summary: 10月23日，火山引擎發佈Seedance2.5 4K，稱其爲該代最強模型。新版經專項訓練，強化人物表情、細微動作與畫面細節，升級重點在畫質與表演。支持Draft樣片模式，用戶可先用480P驗證分鏡、打磨鏡頭，滿意後再生成4K正片，以更優成本探索創意。目前僅供部分企業客戶試用，後續或逐步擴大開放。

sources.title: Kyutai CADRE：將世界模型延遲降至 230 毫秒以下的影片自動編碼器 / Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms
sources.title_zh: Kyutai CADRE：將世界模型延遲降至 230 毫秒以下的影片自動編碼器
sources.title_en: Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms
sources.title_original: Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms
sources.summary: Kyutai released CADRE, a family of 7 open causal diffusion video autoencoders for interactive world models. World models built on CADRE run at 20 fps on 1 H100 and react in under 230 ms. The post Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: Kyutai 發布了 CADRE，這是一個包含 7 個用於互動式世界模型的開放因果擴散影片自動編碼器系列。基於 CADRE 建構的世界模型在 1 張 H100 上以 20 fps 運行，反應時間小於 230 毫秒。本文〈Kyutai CADRE: Video Autoencoders That Cut World Model Lag Below 230 ms〉最初發布於 MarkTechPost。

sources.summary: 10月23日，崑崙萬維旗下AI視頻平臺天工工作臺宣佈接入可靈Kling4.0，面向AI短劇、影視、品牌廣告與電商營銷等場景。此次升級聚焦敘事可控性，支持單次最長30秒視頻原生生成、最多輸入10張關鍵幀，便於控制人物、場景和情節推進，使生成從單一畫面延伸至完整劇情敘事，並增強提示詞能力。具體規格以平臺公告爲準。

stories.title: Etsy宣佈禁止平臺銷售AI生成食譜與手工圖樣

sources.title: Etsy宣佈禁止平臺銷售AI生成食譜與手工圖樣

sources.title_original: Etsy宣佈禁止平臺銷售AI生成食譜與手工圖樣
sources.summary: 美國手工藝品電商平臺Etsy宣佈，10月起禁止商家銷售AI生成的“功能性指南”，包括製作圖樣、烹飪食譜、操作說明等數字下載商品。此舉旨在應對平臺信任危機，遏制AI生成內容對交易體驗的負面衝擊。因買家難辨商品是否含AI內容，該問題已成阻礙交易活躍的核心障礙，誠實賣家也受牽連。

sources.title_original: OpenSSF發布AI漏洞處理指引，強調漏洞驗證與人工審查
sources.summary: AI已能協助開發人員尋找軟體漏洞，攻擊者也開始利用AI發動攻擊，軟體開發團隊因此更需要及早修補漏洞，避免遭攻擊者利用。開源軟體安全基金會（OpenSSF）發布AI漏洞發現與修補指引，由旗下Best Practices及AI/ML工作小組共同制定，提供開發人員利用AI尋找及修補自家軟體漏洞的實務建議，也供協助開發團隊尋找漏洞的資安研究人員參考。

stories.title: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長

sources.title: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長
sources.title_zh: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長
sources.title_original: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長
sources.summary: 美國資安人才招聘業者CyberSN近期分析美國資安職缺刊登情況，發現2026年1月至9月，美國資安職缺刊登量為235,786筆，較2025年同期減少26.4%，創2023年以來同期新低。不過，各類資安職務的職缺變化並不一致，其中資安長（CISO）相關職缺年減38.9%，AI安全工程師（AI Security Engineer）職缺則逆勢年增268.3%。

stories.title: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro / Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro

sources.title: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro / Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.title_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.title_en: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.title_original: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
sources.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026". They're also offering a "Highspeed" version that's 2-3x faster, at twice the price (except for input token cache hits, which are priced the same). The US dollar pricing is $2.00/million tokens for input and $10/million for output - the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half the price of Claude Opus 5.5. Moonshot's own benchmarks show Kimi as approximately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra - beating them on a few benchmarks, coming close on others. Artificial Analysis scored Kimi at 55 - ahead of Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon (all at 53) and behind only Claude Opus 5.5 (58). This is the first time a (soon-to-be) open weight model has scored this highly against the frontier. I tried it out via the Moonshot API using the llm openai endpoint command I added to LLM 0.32 back in August: llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt llm openai endpoint can run prompts against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but doesn't log the results, hence the extra options to save stdout and stderr (the reasoning trace). Here are the pelicans I got for Kimi K3.1 Pro on the three reasoning levels it supports - low, medium, and max. This is max: For comparison, I ran fresh pelicans against Kimi K3 on those three
sources.summary_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro。Kimi K3.1 Pro 今天登陸 Kimi API——它尚未開源權重，但 月之暗面 保證「完整模型權重將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日發布」。他們還提供了一個「高速」版本，速度快 2-3 倍，價格則是兩倍（輸入權杖快取命中除外，價格相同）。其美元定價為輸入每百萬個權杖 2.00 美元，輸出每百萬個權杖 10 美元——與 GPT-6.1 Sol 相同，且為 Claude Opus 5.5 價格的一半。月之暗面的 自己的基準測試顯示 Kimi 與 Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Astra 大致相當——在少數基準測試中勝出，在其他測試中也表現接近。Artificial Analysis 給 Kimi 的評分為 55——領先於 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均為 53），僅落後於 Claude Opus 5.5（58）。這是（即將）開源權重的模型首次在面對前沿模型時獲得如此高的分數。我透過 月之暗面 API 進行了試用，使用的是我在 8 月份新增到 LLM 0.32 中的 llm openai 端點指令：llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt。llm openai endpoint 可以對任何相容 OpenAI 的端點執行提示詞，但不會記錄結果，因此需要額外選項來儲存標準輸出和標準錯誤（推理追蹤）。以下是我針對 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在其支援的三個推理級別（low、medium 和 max）下獲得的鵜鶘圖像。這是 max：作為對比，我針對 Kimi K3 在這三個級別上執行了新的鵜鶘圖像

In a statement to The Verge, Meta spokesperson Daniel Roberts says the terms will go into effect on November 20th "to allow […]

stories.title: TinyFish 解析面向生產環境 AI 代理的代理式搜尋架構 / TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents

sources.title: TinyFish 解析面向生產環境 AI 代理的代理式搜尋架構 / TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
sources.title_zh: TinyFish 解析面向生產環境 AI 代理的代理式搜尋架構
sources.title_en: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
sources.title_original: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
sources.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: TinyFish 發布了兩篇關於代理式搜尋（agentic search）的工程研究文章。其中一篇定義了具備證據合約與有界重試機制的 7 階段生產架構。另一篇則解釋了其深度研究系統為何捨棄獨立的規劃器與每個查詢的子代理。這篇貼文 TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

primary_item.summary: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. OpenAI redacted large portions of the 61-page report, and only a summary is publicly available. The article Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.title_original: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
primary_item.summary_zh: 來自 METR 與 Redwood Research 的外部稽核人員在 OpenAI 進行了為期三週的實地考察，審查該公司用於 AI 代理的內部監控系統，並發現了嚴重的漏洞，GPT-5.5 級別及以上的模型所產生的代理流量中，有多達 25% 未受到監控。OpenAI 對這份 61 頁報告的大部分內容進行了修訂，目前僅公開摘要。本文「Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring」首先出現在 The Decoder。

primary_item.title: 美國資安職缺年減26%，AI安全工程師逆勢成長
primary_item.summary: 美國資安人才招聘業者CyberSN近期分析美國資安職缺刊登情況，發現2026年1月至9月，美國資安職缺刊登量為235,786筆，較2025年同期減少26.4%，創2023年以來同期新低。不過，各類資安職務的職缺變化並不一致，其中資安長（CISO）相關職缺年減38.9%，AI安全工程師（AI Security Engineer）職缺則逆勢年增268.3%。

primary_item.title: Etsy宣佈禁止平臺銷售AI生成食譜與手工圖樣
primary_item.summary: 美國手工藝品電商平臺Etsy宣佈，10月起禁止商家銷售AI生成的“功能性指南”，包括製作圖樣、烹飪食譜、操作說明等數字下載商品。此舉旨在應對平臺信任危機，遏制AI生成內容對交易體驗的負面衝擊。因買家難辨商品是否含AI內容，該問題已成阻礙交易活躍的核心障礙，誠實賣家也受牽連。

primary_item.title: 中國 AI 模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 正在急起直追 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 / Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
primary_item.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores 55 points on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, an 11-point jump over its predecessor that puts it in fourth place. Only three Anthropic and Meta models rank higher. If Moonshot releases the weights as planned, the gap between open and proprietary models shrinks to just three points. The article Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5 appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.title_original: Chinese AI model Kimi K3.1 Pro is closing in on Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5
primary_item.summary_zh: 月之暗面的 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在人工智慧分析智慧指數（Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index）上獲得 55 分，比其前一代大幅提升 11 分，名列第四。僅有三個 Anthropic 和 Meta 模型排名高於它。如果 月之暗面 如期釋出權重，開放原始碼模型與專有模型之間的差距將縮小至僅剩三分。本文「中國 AI 模型 Kimi K3.1 Pro 正在急起直追 Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5」首次發表於 The Decoder。

primary_item.summary: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes. Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.summary: Anthropic had Claude generate mathematical proofs that existing code is correct, producing roughly 180 million lines of proof code for 123 open-source libraries. Along the way, the model caught bugs that years of testing had missed. Anthropic's goal: making formal verification with AI as routine as standard testing. The article Anthropic's Claude now writes code and proves it safe automatically appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.title: TinyFish 解析面向生產環境 AI 代理的代理式搜尋架構 / TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
primary_item.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .

primary_item.title_original: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
primary_item.summary_zh: TinyFish 發布了兩篇關於代理式搜尋（agentic search）的工程研究文章。其中一篇定義了具備證據合約與有界重試機制的 7 階段生產架構。另一篇則解釋了其深度研究系統為何捨棄獨立的規劃器與每個查詢的子代理。這篇貼文 TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents 最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

primary_item.title: 火山引擎發佈Seedance2.54K:480P樣片打磨後生成4K正片
primary_item.summary: 10月23日，火山引擎發佈Seedance2.5 4K，稱其爲該代最強模型。新版經專項訓練，強化人物表情、細微動作與畫面細節，升級重點在畫質與表演。支持Draft樣片模式，用戶可先用480P驗證分鏡、打磨鏡頭，滿意後再生成4K正片，以更優成本探索創意。目前僅供部分企業客戶試用，後續或逐步擴大開放。

primary_item.summary: 據《商業內幕》，Hugging Face週四發佈新模型Carbon-X，面向生物學家，助力DNA研究與新基因療法開發。該開放模型有140億參數，用於DNA理解與生成，創新地將DNA序列與自然語言融入同一模型。研究者可對特定序列提問、預測突變影響、生成新DNA片段，還能輔助其他模型解讀難懂基因。模型基於千問Qwen3-1。

primary_item.summary: Gemini4Argon首秀令谷歌意外：上線72小時吞吐近25萬億Token，消耗量爲Gemini3.0同期3倍，導致谷歌再次啓動算力限流。CEO皮查伊在《Sources》播客覆盤發佈細節，並首次澄清過去數月外界困惑的若干問題，涉及I/O大會相關話題。核心是新品調用爆發、算力承壓與官方迴應。

primary_item.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .

primary_item.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。
